customer_name: Hebei Expressway Group Jingxiong Expressway Branch (河北高速公路集团有限公司京雄分公司)
business_problem: Jingxiong Expressway operators struggled with rigid workflows, fragmented data and systems, weak video perception, and slow emergency handling, which limited the precision and responsiveness of highway operations management.
solution_summary: Hebei Expressway Group's Jingxiong Expressway branch used Baidu AI Cloud to build a highway-operations large model on top of Qianfan ModelBuilder and Qianfan AppBuilder. Baidu pre-trained the model with expressway operating data and tuned it for four specialized domains: event detection, emergency response, information handling, and business interaction. Those capabilities are exposed through seven scenario applications that act as a 'digital operations expert' able to combine perception, cognition, and decision support. The deployment uses professional-terminology understanding, knowledge enhancement, and content generation to detect road events around the clock, generate reports automatically, coordinate multi-party information, and support voice-driven cross-system commands that can reach data, functions, and APIs directly.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model training environment used to pre-train and specialize the highway-operations model on road data.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Organizes the scenario applications and voice-driven interaction flows built on top of the specialized model.

solution_components.name: Highway Industry Large Model
solution_components.role: Acts as the digital operations expert for event detection, emergency handling, report generation, and cross-system coordination.

data_flow: Operational road data is used to pre-train the highway model, which then ingests live event signals and user requests from highway business systems. The model analyzes conditions, drafts response plans or reports, and issues voice-driven commands across systems, data stores, and APIs to coordinate monitoring, emergency action, and information release.
business_outcome: The branch created a model-driven operations layer that improved monitoring accuracy, sped up emergency and information workflows, reduced manual operating effort, and made multi-party highway coordination more intelligent.
metrics: Business-system efficiency is expected to improve 80%+.
Event-detection accuracy is expected to reach 95%+.
Emergency-handling efficiency is expected to improve 80%+.
Information-release efficiency is expected to improve 80%+.
architecture_clues: The deployment creates four specialized models for event detection, emergency disposal, information handling, and business interaction
The solution exposes seven innovation applications for expressway operations
Voice-semantic instructions can reach systems, functions, data, and APIs directly across the operating stack
evidence_quotes: The case describes the industry's first scenario large model for expressway operations management on Jingxiong Expressway in Hebei (original: 行业首个面向高速公路运营管理的场景大模型).
Baidu built the highway industry large model on general large-model capabilities and pre-trained it on expressway operating data (original: 在百度通用大模型能力基础上，基于高速公路运行数据进行预训练，打造高速行业大模型).

The solution forms four specialized models and seven innovative applications for event detection, emergency disposal, information handling, and business interaction (original: 形成面向事件检测、应急处置、信息处置、业务交互四类专属模型和七项创新应用).

It supports voice-driven cross-system, cross-function, cross-data, and cross-API access for queries, knowledge-base calls, information collaboration, report generation, and command issuing (original: 通过语音语义指令就可以实现跨系统直达、跨功能直达、跨数据直达和跨API的打通).

Initial estimates show 80%+ business-system efficiency gains, 95%+ event-detection accuracy, and 80%+ improvements in emergency response and information release (original: 初步测算，业务系统效率提升80%以上，事件检测准确率提升至95%以上，应急处置效率和信息发布效率提升80%以上).
